title: AW27 Men's Colour Stories
summary: AW27 men's colour stories: New Neutrals, Natural Dye and Pink for All.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Neutrals shift: grey toward greyish blue, khaki toward taupe, green or copper, navy toward turquoise or purplish tones<sup>[1]</sup>
- Van den Hoek describes natural dyes from tea, coffee, corn and tree bark, whose limits give richer colour gradations<sup>[2]</sup>
- Pink and mauve are becoming gender-neutral, reaching menswear and even junior sweatshirts<sup>[1]</sup>

sections.heading: New Neutrals
sections.body: Tinted black, greyed blue, copper khaki.

sections.heading: Natural Dye
sections.body: Tea, coffee, corn and bark tones with rich gradations.
